about_the_game:
The war is over.

But some things never truly return home.

After years of serving as a soldier in a world on the brink of collapse, you return to the only place you still call home: your old childhood home. What should have been just a period of rest soon transforms into a silent confrontation with distorted memories, inexplicable presences, and fragments of a past that refuses to remain buried.

As the night progresses, reality begins to crumble. Whispers emerge where no one is. Shadows watch where they shouldn't. What seems like mere psychological strain reveals itself to be something far deeper—and more personal. Every step through the house, the base, and the surrounding area brings you closer to truths that perhaps should never be remembered.

What can we expect from the story?

Shattered Nightmare is a psychological horror action game set in a world devastated by wars, pandemics, and experiments that pushed humanity beyond its limits. Amidst a fragile attempt at global reconstruction, elite military forces were created to contain the chaos, but not everyone emerged unscathed.

You take on the role of a protagonist marked by trauma, doubt, and unstable sanity. While facing real threats and brutal enemies, you will also have to deal with internal manifestations that challenge your perception of reality. Terror is not just around you, it lives within you.

The narrative unfolds in a fragmented and symbolic way, inviting the player to interpret events, characters, and visions without ever offering easy answers.

Inspired by Brazilian settings and a dark post-pandemic universe, the game builds a dense, violent, and psychological experience where every decision, every memory, and every fragment of sanity matters.

Will you be able to confront what you see in the shadows…

or will you get lost among the fragments of your own nightmare?

Game highlights:

  • Psychological horror that challenges the player's sanity;

  • Frenzied combat with melee and firearm mechanics;

  • Switching between first and third person during gameplay;

  • HUD customization options for greater immersion;

  • Rich and detailed setting in a post-pandemic Brazilian setting;

  • A male protagonist with a dense and emotionally charged story.

Prepare for an intense experience, where every decision can affect your perception of reality and where your own fears can become your greatest enemy.

content_descriptors.notes: The game has moments where you will need to engage in physical and "detailed" combat with the enemies you will face during the story.
